purpose: Resolve the three C2-LT-B13 local-review PubMed/manual-route issue rows into source-identity matches or corrected source-route candidates without changing reviewed artifact or model admission status.

scope.selectionRule: Resolve only the three C2-LT-B13 PubMed/manual-route issue rows identified by local review; use NCBI official metadata routes for source identity and route correction, without extracting clinical recommendations or promoting artifacts.
scope.resolutionRule: A matching PMID may proceed only to independent fresh review; a mismatched PMID must remain blocked and requires corrected-source re-extraction before independent fresh review.
nonClaims: This source-resolution register does not change any C2-LT-B13 row into reviewed evidence.
This source-resolution register does not create reviewed artifacts, Source Cards, variables, endpoints or model-ready rows.
This source-resolution register does not authorize endocrine, vestibular, dermatology, skin-care, rehabilitation, clinical or individual advice.
This source-resolution register does not open calibrated prediction, death-date output, intervention ranking or model admission.
This source-resolution register does not extract clinical recommendations or effect sizes from PubMed abstracts.
